description: Every attempted automated fetch of bqk-kos.org (and its env2 mirror) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, including the About-CBK page and the Executive Board decisions page.

result.result_summary: 0 of 2 direct fetches succeeded; all CBK content in this slice was recovered via search-engine indexing of live pages and PDFs.

why_it_matters: The single highest-authority source in this cell is bot-defended. Collection will need a browser-based fetcher with a realistic user agent and polite pacing; the 403 is a hypothesis of WAF filtering, NOT evidence the pages are dead — search indexing shows them live.

description: No dedicated, machine-readable CBK page listing fit-and-proper / senior-management approvals as a separate stream was located. Such approvals appear to be embedded inside dated Executive Board decision posts alongside licensing items.

result.result_summary: Searches in sq, sr and en surfaced individual decision posts (2010, 2014, 2019, 2020) but no consolidated 'approved managers' register.

why_it_matters: Leadership-move extraction must parse free-text decision posts rather than consume a structured register, which raises parsing cost and recall risk.

description: A standalone public register of licensed payment institutions / PSPs (separate from the combined 'Lista e institucioneve financiare' PDF) was not located; Albanian-language searching returned the regulations but no dedicated PSP register page.

result.result_summary: Payments actors appear folded into the general licensed-institutions PDF and into NBFI categories.

why_it_matters: Payments-side leadership and organization tracking must be derived from the combined institution list plus decision posts, so a PSP-specific entity taxonomy has to be built by hand.

description: Serbian-language coverage of CBK personnel/licensing disclosures is materially thinner than Albanian: the sr edition exists (o-cbk/cbk-odluke-odbora, organizaciona-struktura, Godišnji izveštaj) but individual dated decision posts surfaced almost exclusively in Albanian.

result.result_summary: One Serbian query returned the sr section pages and the 2025 annual report, but no sr-language individual decision notices.

why_it_matters: A Serbian-only collector would miss most leadership-move events; Albanian must be the primary collection language for this cell, with sr used for confirmation and for Serb-majority-market actors.

description: No Serbian-language (sr) corporate communications channel was located for any Kosovo commercial bank in this cell. Serbian-language queries ('imenovanje direktor', 'saopštenje') returned only Slovenian/Serbian group-level NLB material and Wikipedia, not a sr version of any Kosovo bank site.

result.result_summary: sr-language own-channel coverage for Kosovo banks appears absent or not indexed; NLB Group (Ljubljana) is the only path to sr/sl-adjacent disclosures about a Kosovo subsidiary.

why_it_matters: The run scope mandates sr coverage; if Kosovo banks genuinely publish only in sq/en, sr-language monitoring must be redirected to parent groups and Serbian-language media rather than bank sites.

description: No dedicated 'press release' or 'media' section could be confirmed for TEB Sh.A. Kosovo, BPB beyond /news/, Banka Ekonomike, or Ziraat Bank Kosova; announcements appear mixed into general news pages or only on social channels.

result.result_summary: Only Raiffeisen, ProCredit and BKT Kosova were confirmed to have a structured, separately-addressable announcements section.

why_it_matters: Collection design cannot assume a uniform 'press room' per bank; for four of eight banks the crawler must target general news pages, governance roster pages and social channels instead.

description: No RSS/Atom or JSON feed was observed on any of the bank sites examined; all listings appear to be plain HTML pages.

result.result_summary: Machine-readable feeds absent across the cell.

why_it_matters: Every source in this cell requires HTML crawling and diffing, raising fragility and maintenance cost; snapshot-diffing of governance roster pages becomes the most reliable detection mechanism.

description: https://www.procreditbank-kos.com/shq/lajme/ returned HTTP 500 on a single fetch attempt, while individual item URLs under the same path and the /eng/pages/njoftime/ listing were indexed by search.

result.result_summary: Treated as transient or path-specific server error, not a dead source.

why_it_matters: A one-off 500 must not cause the ProCredit newsroom to be dropped from the collection plan; the deterministic liveness pass should retry both sq and eng listing paths.

description: Targeted sq and en searches for a recent Raiffeisen Kosovo CEO change surfaced only an existing CEO and a COO/CIO appointment; no 2025-2026 CEO succession announcement was found on any own channel.

result.result_summary: No new-CEO event evidenced for Raiffeisen Kosovo in the searched period.

why_it_matters: Confirms that absence of a press release is common even for large banks — roster-page diffing, not press-release monitoring, must be the primary detection method for this cell.

description: Searched for a dedicated banking/finance tag or vertical on Indeksonline (named in the cell brief). No Indeksonline banking or appointment page surfaced in sq search; results were dominated by bank corporate governance pages (BKT Kosova, ProCredit) instead.

result.result_summary: Indeksonline could not be confirmed in this pass as carrying a distinguishable banking-leadership stream; it remains a plausible general-news mirror rather than an originating source.

why_it_matters: One of the seven outlets named in the cell definition is currently unevidenced, so the cell's assumed breadth is narrower than briefed and Indeksonline should not be given a collection slot until confirmed.

description: Albanian-language queries repeatedly returned English Wikipedia pages ('List of banks in Kosovo', 'Kosovska Banka', 'Banking in Kosovo') in the top results instead of the sq-language local articles being sought, across at least five distinct sq queries.

result.result_summary: General web search is a weak discovery instrument for sq-language Kosovo banking-personnel news; local-language recall is poor.

why_it_matters: Discovery for this cell cannot rely on search engines alone. Collection must be built on direct site-level crawling of the identified portals' category and tag archives, or real A5 events will be missed entirely.

description: Searched in sq for a Kosovo-specific banking trade publication or 'people moves' column analogous to a banking-industry newsletter. None found; the closest is the generalist Buletini Ekonomik and the Kosovo Banking Association's own communications carried via Telegrafi's tag.

result.result_summary: No dedicated banking trade outlet exists for Kosovo in Albanian.

why_it_matters: There is no single high-precision feed for bank personnel moves; the workstream must aggregate many low-precision general outlets and accept higher noise and dedup cost.

description: Direct fetch of https://www.koha.net/arkiva/ekonomi returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. This is a hypothesis of bot defence, not evidence the section is gone — koha.net's root remains referenced across search results.

result.result_summary: Koha's economy archive is unverified by fetch; recorded as bot-defended-but-presumed-live.

why_it_matters: Koha is the daily of record and probably the deepest archive in the cell; if the 403 is not engineered around, the highest-quality Albanian-language A5 archive stays inaccessible.

description: Insajderi surfaced on two live-looking domains (insajderi.com and insajderi.org); Gazeta Express surfaced only via social profiles rather than a confirmed article domain in this pass.

result.result_summary: Canonical web endpoints for two named outlets are unresolved.

why_it_matters: Crawling the wrong domain produces silent under-collection or duplicate events; these must be pinned before either outlet is scheduled.

description: English-language aggregator profiles gave conflicting CEO names for Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo, disagreeing with each other and requiring the bank's own management-board page to adjudicate.

result.result_summary: Third-party business-data aggregators are unreliable for Kosovo bank leadership state.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's premise: media and official pages, not commercial people-databases, must be the ground truth for A5 in Kosovo. It also means every media-sourced appointment needs a bank-website cross-check before it enters the record.

description: No dedicated Serbian-language job/recruitment board for Serb-majority Kosovo surfaced. Searches for bank hiring in Gračanica returned Bosnian Gračanica (MF Banka, radiogracanica.ba, gracanica.gov.ba) — a systematic homonym trap.

result.result_summary: Hiring signal for this cell appears to travel through general news items about 'konkursi' at Serbia-funded institutions rather than through a job portal.

why_it_matters: A5 jobs/hiring coverage for the sr dimension will have to be reconstructed from news text and employer sites; any collector must hard-filter Bosnian Gračanica by domain (.ba) and by co-occurring terms.

description: Searches for named appointments (imenovan direktor) at banks operating in or serving Serb-majority Kosovo returned no sr-language appointment items; results collapsed onto generic CBK/BQK governance pages in English.

result.result_summary: Leadership-move signal in this cell was found only incidentally (a detained Poštanska štedionica director named in reporting), not via appointment announcements.

why_it_matters: Leadership-move intelligence here likely has to come from bank corporate sites, NBS registers and business registries rather than sr media.

description: Canonical domains not established in this pass for: Poštanska štedionica corporate site (posted.co.rs is inferred, not confirmed), Gračanica Online, NGO Aktiv, and Radio/RTV KIM.

result.result_summary: These are recorded as candidates with unverified access_status rather than dropped.

why_it_matters: Four plausibly high-value sr sources cannot be scheduled for collection until their canonical URLs are resolved; a resolution step should precede crawler configuration.

description: RT Balkan (lat.rt.rs) carried the most staff-count-specific item found (38 employees, NLB Komercijalna banka in Kosovo) but is a sanctioned-distribution outlet in parts of the EU.

result.result_summary: Marked collection_allowed=false pending compliance review; the underlying fact should be re-sourced elsewhere.

why_it_matters: Ingesting it uncritically creates both a compliance and a reliability exposure.

description: No public core-banking vendor case study naming a specific Kosovo bank (Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Asseco core banking, Huawei) was found despite direct English queries.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only generic vendor comparison pages and Kosovo banking-sector academic literature; no Kosovo customer reference surfaced.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's premise: Kosovo core-banking selections are not publicly announced by either side, so the collection strategy must lean on hiring ads, integrator announcements and group-level financial reporting instead of vendor case studies.

description: No announcement of a payments/ATM vendor appointing a Kosovo or Western Balkans country manager was located (Payten/ASEE, Printec, Mellon all queried).

result.result_summary: Country-manager queries returned payroll/EOR marketing pages and generic regional payment-modernisation material; no appointment press release found.

why_it_matters: Leadership-move signals for this vendor layer are probably only on LinkedIn personal profiles rather than corporate newsrooms, which changes the collection method (and raises ToS constraints).

description: Serbian-language searching produced no vendor-side Kosovo source.

result.result_summary: The sr query on banking-system suppliers and Pristina implementations returned only CBK regulatory PDFs and Wikipedia bank entries — no supplier, integrator or partner announcement.

why_it_matters: Suggests the Kosovo vendor ecosystem communicates in Albanian and English, and that sr-language collection for this cell should be redirected at Serbia-headquartered vendors' own domains (e.g. mellon.rs, halcom sr locale, ASEE Serbia) rather than at Kosovo-market search terms.

description: No Kosovo bank CIO / head-of-digital appointment announcement was found in either English or Albanian.

result.result_summary: Queries returned international CIO-appointment roundups and Kosovo political/central-bank pages; the only Kosovo-relevant leadership item was the Kosovo Banking Association's cyber-security committee chairmanship election.

why_it_matters: Bank-side technology leadership changes in Kosovo appear to surface mainly through association committee roles and vendor/event speaker lists, reinforcing the pointer strategy for this cell.

description: The routine playbook at C:/Users/User/Dropbox/... could not be read from this macOS environment.

result.result_summary: The stated path is a Windows path unavailable on this host; the method described in the task prompt was followed instead.

why_it_matters: Any playbook-specific taxonomy or scoring conventions not restated in the prompt were unavailable to this slice.

description: No Kosovo-specific banking/fintech AWARDS programme (a domestic 'Banka e Vitit' / 'Menaxheri i Vitit' scheme run inside Kosovo) was found. Searches in sq for 'çmimi banka e vitit Kosovë' and 'menaxheri i vitit' returned only international award programmes (The Banker, Euromoney, Stevie) naming Kosovo as a country category.

result.result_summary: Kosovo banking awards appear to be exclusively foreign-conferred; the domestic award layer, if any, is invisible to search.

why_it_matters: Award citations are a core weak signal for this cell. If no domestic scheme exists, coverage must lean entirely on foreign award pages (some paywalled) plus the winning bank's own press release, which reduces both volume and independence of the signal.

description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for banking conferences, speaker rosters and bank internships in Kosovo produced almost nothing Kosovo-specific. Queries on Kosovska Mitrovica / Ekonomski fakultet / bankarstvo returned Serbia-wide or unrelated academic material; no sr-language banking conference in or about Kosovo was identified.

result.result_summary: Only one usable sr source surfaced (AIK Banka scholarships for students in Kosovo and Metohija) plus an unofficial directory pointer to the Faculty of Economics in Kosovska Mitrovica.

why_it_matters: The Serb-majority north is a real segment of Kosovo's banking labour market and its institutions publish in Serbian only. Without sr sources, leadership and hiring signals from that segment will be systematically missing.

description: No internship, trainee or graduate-programme page was found for TEB Sh.a. Kosovo, BKT Kosova or NLB Banka Kosovo despite targeted sq+en queries. Only the corporate sites and a group-level NLB careers page surfaced.

result.result_summary: Three of the largest Kosovo banks have no discoverable university-pipeline programme via search.

why_it_matters: Either these programmes exist but are published only on login-gated ATS portals / job boards / social media, or they genuinely do not run them. The distinction matters for interpreting 'no internship signal' from these banks as evidence of flat headcount plans.

description: The Kosova Finance Forum / Kosova Business Forum speaker pages (/speaker/ and sq /speaker-2/) were identified via search snippets but their per-edition structure, archive depth and whether past-edition rosters remain online were not established in this pass.

result.result_summary: High-value source located; retention and archiving behaviour unknown.

why_it_matters: If the organiser overwrites the speaker page each edition, historical title snapshots are lost and the source must be captured live each year (plus a web-archive fallback) rather than mined retrospectively.

description: No Kosovo-specific FINTECH conference (as distinct from general finance forums and the general-purpose KosICT technology festival) was identified. Searches in sq and en for fintech conferences in Prishtina returned Albania-based events (Bank of Albania digital banking conference, AAB) or generic tech events.

result.result_summary: The fintech-event layer for Kosovo appears to be absorbed into KFF panels and KosICT tracks rather than existing as a standalone event.

why_it_matters: Speaker rosters for payments/fintech leadership must be extracted from panel-level detail inside broader events, which is harder to automate than a dedicated fintech-conference speaker page.

description: Two of the most information-dense channels for speaker/award-adjacent title data are collection-restricted: LinkedIn company and personal pages (login wall plus ToS prohibition on scraping) and Euromoney award articles (subscription paywall).

result.result_summary: Both recorded as blocked candidates rather than dropped.

why_it_matters: A collection design that assumes LinkedIn scraping will fail legally and technically; the pipeline must route these through analyst review or licensed access and treat the open-web mirrors (association site, winning bank press release) as the collectable substitute.

description: No dedicated bank-workers' or financial-sector trade union was found for Kosovo in Albanian or Serbian searches. Searches for 'sindikata e punëtorëve bankarë' and 'sindikat bankarskih radnika Kosovo' returned no such organisation, only general private-sector union coverage and individual dismissal cases.

result.result_summary: Grievance signal for banks is not channelled through a sectoral union; it appears via the Labour Inspectorate, courts, individual complainants and media instead.

why_it_matters: Collection design for this cell must not wait on a bank union feed that does not exist; the inspectorate/court/registry path is the load-bearing one.

description: No public dataset or register of collective-redundancy notifications ('largime kolektive') filed by employers in Kosovo was located; the Labour Inspectorate publishes aggregate inspection statistics and ad-hoc notices, not case-level or employer-level redundancy filings.

result.result_summary: Employer-level redundancy events must be reconstructed from complaints, judgments, registry changes and media rather than read off a register.

why_it_matters: Sets expectations for coverage: the cell yields case-level anecdotes plus aggregate statistics, not a clean event feed.

description: Multiple independent sources (CSO monitoring reports, RFE/RL, news coverage) describe the Labour Inspectorate as under-resourced (~53 inspectors nationwide) and limited in transparency, with a documented nine-month delay against a statutory 30-day deadline in the ProCredit Bank complaints.

result.result_summary: Inspectorate output lags events substantially and is incomplete, especially for the private sector.

why_it_matters: Timeliness assumptions for inspectorate-derived signals must be measured in quarters, not weeks; media and registry sources will usually lead it.

description: Employee-review platforms (Glassdoor) carry Kosovo-filtered content for at least Raiffeisen Bank International, but their terms prohibit automated collection and review lists are partly gated. No Kosovo-specific coverage was found on any local employer-review platform; none appears to exist.

result.result_summary: Review-site signal is usable only manually or under licence, and only for the international bank groups.

why_it_matters: Constrains what would otherwise be the fastest sentiment/attrition indicator for this cell.

description: Serbian-language searching produced rich results for bank branch closures and staff redundancies in the north and enclaves (NLB Komercijalna: branch plus nine outlets, 38 employees affected, severance/voluntary-departure programmes) but produced no Serbian-language union actor specific to Kosovo bank employees; affected staff appealed to Serbian government bodies rather than to a union.

result.result_summary: Serbian-language coverage is essential for branch-closure/redundancy signals but has no union pointer of its own.

why_it_matters: Confirms sr-language monitoring of KoSSev/Radio KIM/Kontakt Plus is mandatory, and that the grievance route in the north is political rather than union-mediated.

description: The SITP labour-market barometer (sitp.rks-gov.net) and KosovaJob were identified but not fetched in this run, so their export/API capability and terms of use are unconfirmed. Neither should be recorded as live or as machine-collectable until the deterministic verification pass runs.

result.result_summary: Two high-value candidates carry lower confidence pending verification.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-promising a structured financial-sector headcount series that may only exist as an on-screen dashboard.

description: Emerging Europe (emerging-europe.com), named in the cell definition, did not surface in any result set for Kosovo fintech/payments leadership queries.

result.result_summary: Queries returned Fintech Times, The Recursive, KCDF and researchgate items instead; no emerging-europe.com article on Kosovo payments leadership was found.

why_it_matters: The assumed aggregator may have thin or discontinued Kosovo people coverage; the cell should not depend on it without direct site-search verification.

description: No Kosovo-specific article from The Banker (thebanker.com) was located.

result.result_summary: Seed query returned only tangential items (EBRD appointment via Balkan Green Energy News, Kosovo Banking Association journal, Wikipedia). The Banker's Kosovo footprint appears limited to database entries.

why_it_matters: Global trade titles are unlikely to be a primary channel for Kosovo people moves; local/association and regional newswire sources should carry the weight.

description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for Kosovo banking management-change analysis returned almost exclusively CBK primary documents and academic PDFs, not a regional analyst/aggregator layer.

result.result_summary: Query 'analiza bankarski sektor Kosovo promene u upravi izveštaj Zapadni Balkan' returned CBK Godišnji Izveštaj PDFs, a Kosovo government reform-agenda PDF and a ResearchGate comparative study.

why_it_matters: There appears to be no sr-language aggregator specialised in Kosovo bank people moves; sr coverage must be taken from CBK's own Serbian editions plus Serbian general business media (outside this cell).

description: SeeNews and bne IntelliNews article bodies are assumed subscription-gated but this was not tested in this pass.

result.result_summary: Only search-result snippets and section URLs were observed; no fetch of a full article body was attempted.

why_it_matters: Collection design (headline-only vs full-text) depends on the real gate; a deterministic access test is needed before building collectors.

description: An Albanian-language tabloid item (paparaci.com) alleging a Kosovo bank director concealed citizenship from the CBK surfaced in sq search.

result.result_summary: Found at paparaci.com; sensational outlet, single-sourced, not corroborated.

why_it_matters: Such outlets do generate real leads on fit-and-proper disputes but must never be treated as evidence; flagged as noisy, not added as a candidate for this aggregator-focused cell.

description: No group-level press release or ad-hoc announcement dedicated specifically to a Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo CEO/management-board appointment was found in the searches run. RBI's 2025 board-reorganisation release is group-level only.

result.result_summary: RBI publishes network-bank leadership changes inconsistently; Kosovo-unit appointments appear to surface mainly on the local Raiffeisen Kosovo governance pages rather than in group press releases.

why_it_matters: Collection for RBI/Kosovo must lean on roster diffing of raiffeisen-kosovo.com rather than expecting a group release; a release-only strategy would miss appointments.

description: Albanian-language query for a BKT Kosova new-executive announcement ('drejtor i ri menaxhues njoftim') returned only static governance pages, no press announcement.

result.result_summary: BKT Kosova appears not to publish leadership-change press releases in a crawlable news section; only the Bordi i Drejtorëve roster page reflects changes.

why_it_matters: Confirms roster-diff as the required method for the Çalık/BKT branch and marks BKT as a low-signal publisher for A5.

description: Turkish-language search for a KAP disclosure covering TEB board changes touching TEB Sh.A. Kosova returned no specific filing.

result.result_summary: KAP is the correct statutory venue and TEB entities file there, but no Kosovo-specific board disclosure was surfaced by general web search; the KAP portal itself must be queried directly.

why_it_matters: Web search is a poor proxy for KAP contents; a direct KAP company-filtered query must be built into the collection plan or the TEB/BNP branch will look empty.

description: Serbian/BCS-language query for an NLB Group announcement of an NLB Banka Prishtina management appointment ('imenovan član uprave', 'saopštenje') returned no such release.

result.result_summary: NLB's Kosovo-unit governance communication appears to run through the local Albanian/English site and Slovene-language SEOnet filings rather than Serbian-language group releases.

why_it_matters: Serbian-language monitoring is low-yield for the NLB/Kosovo branch specifically; Slovene (sl) is the more productive non-local language here, which is outside the declared run language set (sq/sr/en).

description: No Ziraat group announcement naming a Ziraat Bank Kosova general-manager appointment was found; only the Kosovo unit's own senior-management page and group-level Turkish appointments.

result.result_summary: Ziraat's group communications enumerate foreign subsidiaries but do not routinely announce Kosovo-unit management changes.

why_it_matters: The Ziraat branch of this cell will depend on subsidiary roster diffing plus Turkish agency reporting, not group IR.

description: No Kosovo-specific payments-industry trade press, PSP-only newsletter, or acquiring/processing trade association website was found. Payments-sector employer news is scattered across general news outlets, the banking association magazine and the FIKS cluster page.

result.result_summary: Searches in sq and en for payments-sector trade media returned only general news outlets and the Kosovo Banking Association magazine on Issuu.

why_it_matters: Without a trade-press spine, the cell must rely on aggregating many low-volume company channels, raising collection cost and the risk of missing leadership moves at small PSPs.

description: English-language searches for Kosovo acquiring/merchant-services vacancies were dominated by US job aggregators (ZipRecruiter, SimplyHired, Indeed) and employer-of-record marketing pages, with no genuine Kosovo payments vacancies.

result.result_summary: The query 'Kosovo payment service provider hiring acquiring merchant services jobs' returned zero Kosovo-domiciled payments vacancies; all hits were US-centric or EOR vendor content.

why_it_matters: Confirms that English-only collection is structurally inadequate for this cell and that global aggregators must be excluded or heavily filtered to avoid polluting the signal set.

description: Serbian-language (sr) coverage of the Kosovo payments-employer landscape is very thin. Searches using 'platni promet', 'usluge plaćanja', 'zapošljavanje', 'oglasi za posao' and 'Severna Mitrovica' produced no Kosovo-Serb payments employer, no local job portal, and no vacancy listings — only Belgrade press on the dinar payment-traffic dispute and unrelated Serbian job ads.

result.result_summary: One relevant sr article (Vreme, on the payment-traffic ban and NLB Komercijalna branch closures); no sr-language hiring source located.

why_it_matters: The run mandates sr coverage. A structural sr blind spot means payments-related job losses/creation in northern municipalities would be detected only through Albanian or English secondary reporting, with delay and bias.

description: Candidate local wallet/processor brand names probed speculatively ('Sendway', 'Klix', 'MPay') returned no evidence of being Kosovo payments operators. 'Rrota' resolved to a Kosovar creative/consulting company, not a payments firm.

result.result_summary: No corroboration found; these names are NOT recorded as payments actors.

why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated actor map. The verified non-bank payments actor set for Kosovo currently rests on Paysera, OneFor, Swinto, Numarics, Moneta, Unioni Financiar Prishtinë and PayLink (AL-registered).

description: The BQK licensed-institutions page returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on direct fetch.

result.result_summary: 403 on https://bqk-kos.org/mbikeqyrja-financiare/institucionet-financiare-te-licencuara-2/?lang=en; the site is clearly live (its PDFs are indexed and served).

why_it_matters: The single most authoritative actor-map source needs a browser-grade fetcher. Recorded as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead.

description: No public careers page was located for the bank-owned acquiring arms named in the cell brief (e.g. ProCredit or Raiffeisen acquiring/merchant-services units) as separate hiring entities. Their payments roles surface only inside the parent bank's postings on KosovaJob.

result.result_summary: Payments roles appear as bank departments ('Payments and Back Office Department'), not as distinct acquiring-arm employers.

why_it_matters: Means the cell's 'separate legal entity' premise holds for EMIs/MTOs/processors but not for bank acquiring in Kosovo; acquiring signals must be extracted from bank job ads by role-title matching (acquiring, POS, merchant, kartela, PCI).

description: Neither kosovajob.com nor ofertapune.net exposes an RSS/Atom feed in its page markup, and no public API was found for either. KosovaJob additionally has no stable industry-category URL for banking - it uses company-slug pages and a search box filtering 'sipas Pozites, Qytetit, ose Industrise' whose category endpoints are not exposed in the HTML.

result.result_summary: Collection must be HTML crawl + diff, not feed subscription; per-employer crawling is the only reliable banking slice on KosovaJob.

why_it_matters: Rules out the cheapest collection design and raises the fragility of the whole cell to site redesigns; also means listing publication dates must be inferred (e.g. from the boards' Facebook post timestamps).

description: portalpune.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no body on direct fetch, while its tag pages are search-indexed and its Facebook page posts fresh job links daily. This is bot defence, not a dead site.

result.result_summary: Recorded as blocked/unverified, not dead; Facebook feed identified as the workaround index.

why_it_matters: A naive liveness pass would drop a high-volume bank-vacancy source. The 403 must be treated as a hypothesis pending a headless-browser retry.

description: Searched in Serbian for Kosovo bank vacancies ('konkurs za posao banka Kosovo Mitrovica oglasi posao srpski jezik'). No Kosovo-specific Serbian-language job board was found - only Serbia-wide boards (Infostud, HelloWorld, Poslovi.rs, KlikDoPosla) that carry a thin Kosovska Mitrovica location page. None of those pages surfaced an actual bank vacancy in the results reviewed.

result.result_summary: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo banking vacancies exists only as a thin location filter on Serbia-wide boards.

why_it_matters: Hiring by Serbian-system financial institutions in northern Kosovo may be effectively invisible to this cell; the sr dimension cannot be assumed covered just because sr boards were catalogued.

description: Albanian job vocabulary does not distinguish Kosovo from Albania. njoftime.com and gjirafa jobs mix XK and AL listings, and the sharpest payments-role hit found ('Specialist - Departamenti i Kartave dhe Pagesave') is a Tirana vacancy. 'Bankë', 'konkurs', 'vende pune' are all high-noise on their own.

result.result_summary: Every sq query needs an XK disambiguator (city names: Prishtinë, Prizren, Pejë, Ferizaj, Gjakovë, Mitrovicë, Podujevë) or an XK-registered employer name.

why_it_matters: Without geo-disambiguation the cell will silently import Albanian market signals into Kosovo org-change conclusions.

description: No job board in this cell was found to publish executive appointments, board changes, or departures. Boards carry vacancies only; senior roles (Head of Digital Banking, CIO, Chief Compliance Officer) were not observed advertised on the sq boards reviewed - such hires appear to be executive-search or internal.

result.result_summary: The 'leadership moves' topic is largely NOT served by this cell.

why_it_matters: Leadership-move signal must come from another cell (press releases, BQK licensing/fit-and-proper notices, LinkedIn, media). Over-relying on job boards would under-detect C-level change.

description: Kosovo boards remove listings after the application deadline ('skadon' / 'mbyllet sot'); no public archive of expired bank ads was found on kosovajob.com, ofertapune.net or portalpune.com.

result.result_summary: Historical vacancy series cannot be reconstructed retroactively from these boards.

why_it_matters: The org-change signal is only available going forward, and only if the collector snapshots full ad text at discovery time. njoftime.com forum threads are the one partial exception since threads persist.

description: No dedicated LinkedIn company page for Banka Ekonomike sh.a. surfaced in any query, although employee profiles referencing 'Banka Ekonomike SH.A.' were indexed.

result.result_summary: Employee profiles exist but no confirmed /company/ URL was observed. Not recorded as non-existent — only as not found by search. Requires a direct in-app LinkedIn company search to confirm.

why_it_matters: Banka Ekonomike is a domestically-owned bank; missing its page leaves a hole in the org-change watchlist for exactly the segment least covered by international press.

description: Every individual role-change announcement search ('excited to announce', 'joining as', 'pozicion i ri', 'imenovan') returned only profile stubs, never the actual post.

result.result_summary: LinkedIn member posts and activity feeds are not reliably indexed by general web search and are login-gated; the highest-value signal in this cell (individual self-announcements) is not retrievable via search engines.

why_it_matters: The cell's core hypothesis — individuals announce moves before employers — cannot be operationalised by open-web crawling. Collection must be either a logged-in analyst workflow, LinkedIn Sales Navigator alerts, or a licensed data vendor.

description: No Kosovo-specific Albanian idiom for LinkedIn role-change announcements was confirmed.

result.result_summary: Queries using 'pozicion i ri', 'emërohet drejtor i ri' returned no matching announcement posts; Kosovar banking professionals appear to announce moves predominantly in English on LinkedIn, with Albanian reserved for employer recruitment posts.

why_it_matters: Monitoring rules should not assume Albanian-language announcement phrasing for individual moves; Albanian keywords are however essential for employer job ads (KosovaJob, Raiffeisen Career).

description: Serbian-language professional-network signal for Kosovo banking is very thin.

result.result_summary: sr-language queries returned generic job boards, Wikipedia entries and a Serbia-registered NLB Komercijalna page; no Kosovo-north-specific banking LinkedIn presence was found.

why_it_matters: Org change in the parallel/northern banking layer will likely be invisible in this cell and must be picked up by a different workstream (press, regulator, municipal sources).

description: LinkedIn alumni/university flow data (e.g. UBT, RIT Kosovo graduates into banks) could not be reached.

result.result_summary: The alumni tool is entirely behind login; no open-web proxy was found in this pass.

why_it_matters: Alumni flow was a stated sub-target of this cell; it is currently uncollectable without an authenticated workflow.

description: BIFIDEX, the Western Balkans joint business-registers platform, offers exactly the capability this cell wants — real-time notification when any change is recorded in the official register for a company or its authorised persons — but its published member coverage is Serbia, Montenegro, Bosnia & Herzegovina (RS), North Macedonia and Albania. No Kosovo registry membership was found.

result.result_summary: Searched for Bifidex + Kosovo; all member listings found omit Kosovo. Also noted the platform's governance is described as institutionally fragile with periods of inactivity.

why_it_matters: There is no off-the-shelf regional change-notification service covering Kosovo registry filings, so change detection for XK must be built in-house by diffing ARBK snapshots.

description: No open, bulk or machine-readable feed of Kosovo company OFFICERS/DIRECTORS/SHAREHOLDERS was found. OpenCorporates records officers, directors, shareholders and accounts as not available for the Kosovo register (Open Company Data Index score 15/100), and reporting indicates automated bulk extraction from the ARBK portal for commercial redistribution is not authorised.

result.result_summary: Officer-level data appears obtainable only per-entity, via the ARBK portal extract or paid extract brokers.

why_it_matters: Monitoring leadership change through the register will be per-entity and rate-limited, so a tightly curated watchlist (driven by the BQK licensed-institutions list) is mandatory rather than optional.

description: Searching in Albanian for a Kosovo beneficial-ownership register (regjistri i pronarëve përfitues) returned only ARBK's general pages and Serbia's UBO register. No dedicated public Kosovo UBO register portal was identified in this pass.

result.result_summary: Beneficial-owner information appears to be collected by BQK during fit-and-proper assessment rather than exposed in a public searchable UBO register.

why_it_matters: Ultimate ownership changes behind banks/PSPs may not be publicly observable in Kosovo; this limits the pointer value of the registry for ownership (as opposed to director) change.

description: The exact URL and query interface of ARBK's public company SEARCH (as opposed to the login/registration front-end at rbk.rks-gov.net and the informational site at arbk.rks-gov.net) was not pinned down in this pass, nor was it confirmed which officer fields appear in a free public result.

result.result_summary: Secondary sources state basic search is free, English-capable and account-free, but this was not established from the portal itself.

why_it_matters: Collection design (what can be diffed automatically vs what needs a paid extract) depends on this; it should be resolved by a hands-on portal walkthrough, not more searching.

description: Unlike many jurisdictions, no evidence was found that the Kosovo Official Gazette publishes routine COMPANY filings (director changes, statute amendments) — it appears to carry laws, regulations and state-body decisions/appointments instead.

result.result_summary: GZK is valuable for public-sector and central-bank appointments, but is unlikely to be a systematic feed of private bank/PSP director changes.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-investment in gazette monitoring as a substitute for registry monitoring for commercial entities.

description: Sources reference downloading full Commercial Court decisions from the court's official website, but the specific decisions-publication URL on the Kosovo judiciary domain was not located in this pass; the cases are also still being migrated from manual registers into the SMIL electronic case-management system.

result.result_summary: Only aggregated third-party compilations of Commercial Court decisions were found directly.

why_it_matters: Contested director removals and shareholder disputes may be visible only through the court; the canonical publication endpoint still needs to be identified.

description: The e-Prokurimi homepage fetch did not expose a discoverable notice-search or award-notice browse URL; only a news archive and a contracting-authority list link were resolvable. Individual notices are reachable only via opaque numeric IDs (DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=NNNNNNN).

result.result_summary: Notice-level browsing endpoint not identified from the homepage; ID-based deep links confirmed to exist. This is a hypothesis about the site structure, not evidence the search function is absent — an authenticated or JS-driven search UI very likely exists.

why_it_matters: A collector will probably need ID enumeration, sitemap discovery or a headless-browser session rather than a simple listing crawl; effort estimate for the highest-value source in this cell should be raised accordingly.

description: Targeted searches for Kosovo public tenders specifically naming POS terminals, card acquiring or payment-processing services (sq: 'terminale POS', 'shërbime të procesimit të pagesave') returned no matching award notice.

result.result_summary: No POS/acquiring-specific public contract award notice was found in open web search. The closest confirmed payments-infrastructure procurement is BQK's 'TIPS Clone Connectivity Services' contract award notice (instant payments), found on bqk-kos.org.

why_it_matters: Suggests such procurements are either rare, bundled under generic 'shërbime bankare' or IT CPV codes, or only visible inside e-Prokurimi's search — meaning keyword monitoring must use CPV codes and broad Albanian terms, not English payments jargon.

description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for Kosovo public financial institutions' vacancies and tenders was heavily polluted by Republic of Serbia institutions (mfin.gov.rs, trezor.gov.rs, mup.rs) that share the exact same terminology.

result.result_summary: Only one genuinely Kosovo-based sr-language public vacancy source was confirmed (Posta e Kosovës 'Javni Konkurs Za Radno Mesto'). No sr-language vacancy or tender page was confirmed on the sites of MFPT, FSDK, KCGF or Trusti, though the Public Procurement Rules require preliminary notices in Albanian, Serbian and English.

why_it_matters: sr is a mandated official language in Kosovo, so sr-language notices should exist; failing to find them via general search means the collector must go to the institution sites' sr language toggles directly. Also flags 'Ministarstvo finansija', 'Trezor', 'javne nabavke', 'konkurs' as high-noise terms requiring a site: or geographic qualifier ('Kosovo', 'Priština', 'rks-gov.net').

description: A plain fetch of mf.rks-gov.net (Ministry of Finance, Labour and Transfers) did not return the site's menu URLs for konkurse, prokurimi, Thesari or organizational structure.

result.result_summary: Homepage content rendered without resolvable section links; likely a JS-driven menu. Treated as unverified, not dead — the ministry site is clearly live and referenced by other official sources.

why_it_matters: The ministry site needs a browser-based or sitemap-based crawl; in the interim, konkursi.rks-gov.net and kosovajob.com cover its vacancy flow.

description: No single official page was located that lists appointments/dismissals of senior Treasury (Thesari) officials, e.g. the Director of Treasury.

result.result_summary: The Official Gazette (gzk.rks-gov.net) is the likely repository for such government decisions but no appointment decision was retrieved via general search.

why_it_matters: Leadership-move detection for Treasury will require direct querying of the GZK act database plus media monitoring, rather than a ready-made feed.

description: Searched specifically for a currently branded 'EU4Kosovo' financial-sector programme with published expert calls, in Albanian ('projekt ekspert konkurs punësimi').

result.result_summary: No EU4Kosovo financial-sector project page or expert call surfaced. The 'EU4...' naming convention was confirmed in the region (e.g. EU4PFM in Montenegro seeking junior/senior non-key experts), but no Kosovo financial-sector equivalent was found in this pass.

why_it_matters: The seed query assumed a named programme that may not exist under that label for Kosovo; the collector should instead anchor on the EU Office in Kosovo (EEAS) and TED IPA notices rather than a programme brand.

description: Sought a current EBRD Kosovo bank-advisory / financial-institution consultant assignment notice.

result.result_summary: Kosovo EBRD consultancy notices are demonstrably published on ECEPP (roads supervision, Gjilan wastewater PIU support), but no banking/payments advisory assignment appeared in general web results — ECEPP notices are poorly indexed by search engines.

why_it_matters: Confirms that this channel must be harvested from ECEPP directly on a schedule rather than via search engines; absence in search is not absence in the portal.

description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for donor/IFI financial-sector consultant notices relating to Kosovo returned essentially nothing Kosovo-specific.

result.result_summary: Terms 'oglas', 'konsultant', 'bankarski sektor', 'konkurs' pulled results from Serbia, Bosnia and Montenegro (EU4PFM, eufondovikonkursi.com) rather than Kosovo. Donor and IFI notices for Kosovo appear overwhelmingly in English and secondarily Albanian.

why_it_matters: Serbian-language monitoring for this cell should be scoped narrowly (EEAS Kosovo _sr pages, e-Prokurimi Serbian versions, North-Kosovo institutions) rather than run as broad web search, or it will generate cross-border noise.

description: TED was searched for Kosovo financial-sector technical-assistance notices via general web search.

result.result_summary: Only TED's own explanatory pages and one unrelated 2014 Kosovo education TA notice surfaced. TED notice bodies are not reliably reachable through general search.

why_it_matters: TED must be collected via its API/bulk packages with CPV and place-of-performance filters; treating web search as the access path would systematically miss this cell's most authoritative channel.

description: Devex and DevelopmentAid carry the richest consolidated view of Kosovo-relevant donor consultant roles and tender history.

result.result_summary: Both gate detail behind subscriptions; only titles, organisations and partial metadata are publicly visible.

why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decision needed if this cell is to be covered at depth; otherwise rely on primary portals and accept lag.

description: Direct WebFetch of https://bankassoc-kos.com/about-us/board-of-directors/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.

result.result_summary: The same site is well indexed with fresh content and other paths (/Al/komunikatat/..., /uploads/files/...) resolve in search results, so the 403 is almost certainly bot defence (WAF/user-agent filtering), not a dead page. Recorded as unverified-but-presumed-live; requires a headless browser or a realistic UA for collection.

why_it_matters: This is the single highest-value page in the cell. Mis-recording it as dead would silently drop the primary Kosovo bank-leadership signal from the collection plan.

description: AmCham Kosovo's legacy domain amchamksv.org 301-redirects to amcham.network.

result.result_summary: https://www.amchamksv.org/all-members/ returned 301 to https://amcham.network/. The new domain exposes tiered member directories, a committees category, board of governors and newsroom. Legacy deep links (e.g. /finance/, /financial-service/, the 2026 board-election story) still surface in search and may or may not redirect cleanly.

why_it_matters: Any stored AmCham URLs from earlier runs will need rewriting; a naive liveness check on old deep links could mark good sources dead.

description: No dedicated Kosovo association of payment service providers / e-money institutions was found in any of the three languages.

result.result_summary: Searches in Albanian ('shoqata e pagesave elektronike', 'shoqata e institucioneve të pagesave', 'PSP anëtarë') returned only the banking association, the microfinance association and the FIKS fintech community. The nearest substitute is FIKS (fintechkosovo.com), which lists founding members but publishes no board or full membership roster.

why_it_matters: PSPs and e-money institutions — a core part of the payments actor map — are not covered by any association directory in Kosovo. Their enumeration must come from the CBK licence register instead (a different cell), not from the association layer.

description: A Kosovo insurance association (Shoqata e Siguruesve të Kosovës) could not be confirmed as an active, separately-governed body with a public member/board page.

result.result_summary: Albanian search surfaced bks-ks.org (apparently the Kosovo Insurance Bureau / Byroja Kosovare e Sigurimit) rather than a member association with published committees. Not fetched in this pass; treated as a lead, not a candidate.

why_it_matters: Insurers are adjacent buyers of payments and IT infrastructure; if a governed association exists it would add another named-executive roster to the map.

description: STIKK membership scale and board composition are reported inconsistently across sources.

result.result_summary: Third-party profiles state '200+ members, 90% of the ICT market' while STIKK's own about page states 'over 100 members representing over 60% of the ICT labor market'. Search snippets also showed a board chaired by Burbuqe Hashimi (3CIS) whereas the live page shows Astrit Leti (Tive) as chairman with a substantially different roster.

why_it_matters: Confirms the board page turns over between terms and must be snapshotted with an observed-at date; also a warning never to cite association scale figures without attributing the specific source and date.

description: Serbian-language association sources for the banking/payments sector specifically are close to non-existent.

result.result_summary: Serbian queries ('Udruženje banaka Kosova', 'članovi upravni odbor') returned almost entirely Serbian-state institutions (Udruženje banaka Srbije, PKS) rather than Kosovo bodies. The only genuinely Kosovo-relevant Serbian-language material was general business-association organising covered by KoSSev and the parallel Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije.

why_it_matters: The Serb-majority north's financial-sector actors are not represented in any association directory reachable in Serbian; sr-language coverage for this cell will remain thin and must be met via news monitoring rather than directories.

description: No association-hosted job board for the Kosovo banking sector was found.

result.result_summary: Neither SHBK, AMIK nor the chambers appear to run a sector vacancy board; only OEK's /konkurset/ and AmCham's own vacancy notices exist, and both are association-internal rather than sector-wide.

why_it_matters: The 'jobs' topic cannot be served from the association layer in Kosovo; it must be sourced from bank career pages and commercial job portals (a different cell).
